description: This file defines an abstract class 'XAxisRenderer' within the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace which serves as a base class for rendering X axis components in a charting library. It inherits from 'AxisRenderer' and provides initialization and a default tick label formatting method.

classes.name: XAxisRenderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for all X axis renderers in the charting library.

methods.name: GetDefaultTickLabelsFormat
methods.description: Returns the default string format for tick labels, which is '0'.
